title: 电位器调光
summary: 把电位器当可变电阻，转动旋钮改变 LED 亮度。
description: 电位器有 3 只脚：1、3 之间是固定的 10 kΩ，中间 2 脚是滑动端。把 2 脚和 3 脚连在一起，它就变成一个 0–10 kΩ 的可变电阻。电路：+5 V → 电位器 1 脚；2、3 脚相连 → 220 Ω 保护电阻 → 红色 LED → GND。

cards.title: 转一转，灯会变
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**。搭好后单击电位器，在「属性」里拖动**旋钮**，看 LED 怎么变。

cards.title: 电位器是一根能滑动的电阻条
text: - 1、3 两脚之间是一整条 10 kΩ 的电阻，2 脚是在上面**滑动的触点**。旋钮在 1 脚那头时，1–2 之间≈0；在 3 脚那头时≈10 kΩ。
- 把 2、3 脚连起来，电位器就成了一个 **0–10 kΩ 的可变电阻**，串在 LED 的路上。电阻越大，电流越小，灯越暗。
- **为什么还要 220 Ω？** 旋钮转到 0 时电位器一点电阻都没有，没有它，LED 就直接接在 5 V 上了（第 1.3 课你见过后果）。

cards.title: 搭好，再用 LED 的电流验证
text: - 电位器三只脚占三个相邻的列，中间那列是滑动端。用一根短跳线把 2 脚那列和 3 脚那列连起来。
- **+5 V 接 1 脚**（最左边那列）：旋钮在 0% 时电阻最小，灯最亮。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 同一个电位器两种接法：**三只脚都用**，它是分压器（中间脚输出一个可调电压）；**只用两只脚**，它是可变电阻。
- 用可变电阻调光很浪费：多出来的电压全变成了电位器里的热。以后学了 PWM（第 5 世界），会用开关得飞快的方法调光，几乎不发热。

caption.text: 2、3 脚接在一起，电位器就是一个 0–10 kΩ 的可变电阻：阻值越大，电流 I 越小。220 Ω 保证旋到 0 时也有限流。

i18n.en: With pins 2 and 3 joined the pot is a 0–10 kΩ variable resistor: more resistance, less current I. The 220 Ω still limits the current at 0.

en.title: Potentiometer dimmer
en.summary: Use a potentiometer as a variable resistor and turn the knob to change the LED brightness.
en.description: A potentiometer has 3 pins: a fixed 10 kΩ between 1 and 3, and the wiper on pin 2. Join pins 2 and 3 and it becomes a 0–10 kΩ variable resistor. Circuit: +5 V → pot pin 1; pins 2 and 3 joined → 220 Ω protective resistor → red LED → GND.
hints: The pot's three pins take three neighbouring columns; the middle one is the wiper, pin 2.
Join pin 2's column and pin 3's column with a short jumper.
+5 V goes to pin 1 (the leftmost column).

cards.title: Turn it and the light changes
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**. Then click the potentiometer and drag its **knob** in Properties; watch the LED.

cards.title: A pot is a resistor strip with a slider
text: - Between pins 1 and 3 is one strip of 10 kΩ; pin 2 is a **contact that slides along it**. With the knob at pin 1's end, 1–2 is ≈ 0; at pin 3's end, ≈ 10 kΩ.
- Join pins 2 and 3 and the pot becomes a **0–10 kΩ variable resistor** in the LED's path. More resistance, less current, dimmer light.
- **Why the 220 Ω as well?** At 0 the pot has no resistance at all; without it the LED would sit straight across 5 V (you saw the result in 1.3).

cards.title: Build it, then check with the LED current
text: - The pot takes three neighbouring columns; the middle one is the wiper. Join the wiper column and the pin-3 column with a short jumper.
- **+5 V goes to pin 1** (the leftmost column): at 0% the resistance is lowest and the LED brightest.

cards.title: Take away
text: - One pot, two uses: **all three pins**, it is a divider (the middle pin outputs an adjustable voltage); **two pins**, it is a variable resistor.
- Dimming with a variable resistor wastes power: the extra voltage turns into heat in the pot. With PWM (World 5) you will dim by switching very fast instead, with almost no heat.

measurements.ask: Knob at 0%: click the LED — the current in Properties
measurements.explain: The pot is close to 0 Ω, leaving only 220 Ω: (5 − 1.8) / (220 + 12) ≈ 13.8 mA.
With 10 kΩ more: (5 − 1.8) / (10 220 + 12) ≈ 0.31 mA — too dim to see.

measurements.ask: 旋钮在 0%：单击 LED，「属性」里的电流

hints: 电位器三只脚占三个相邻的列；中间那列是滑动端 2 脚。
用一根短跳线把 2 脚所在的列和 3 脚所在的列连起来。
+5 V 接 1 脚（最左边那列）。
